scope.why_new_input: The paid four-even guide remained open and its true odd center created 1.1258e17 energy; the old frozen large Cramer row units left a 2.19e18 original residual. This is a different physical mother, a prepared joint moment guide, and the original implicit acceleration mass equations.
scope.fixed_physical_model: R598: 18 complete blocks, 576 micro packets, epsilon=1/12000, positions 5+.99*x for roots P6+tau*P5 with tau=-1,0,1, fixed [4,6] window, each open collar 1/3000
scope.physical_amplitude: Each actual complete copy has (2*w)^(1/4)*epsilon^(7/4)/256 times its 32-packet pattern
scope.reference_quartic_integral: Six unrotated tau=0 reference blocks, total factor 6=3*2, one factor w; raw arrays omit (2*w)^(1/4). Only proved homogeneous quartic expressions use this representation.
scope.new_exact_graph: 80-digit evaluation of the R598 exact algebraic definitions, no unrun floating node estimate used as the spacing proof
scope.new_prepared_guide: 11 bounded Fourier/tanh height-curvature-length parameters; a unique monotone constant c is defined by integral h*k=0; prepared odd center retained and the remaining seven actual endpoint moments are fitted together
scope.actual_guide_scalar_numerics: The continuous monotone root is approximated by fixed positive Gauss96 plus brentq; c is frozen in subsequent fine history and frame evaluation. All eight numerical endpoint moment defects, including p2, are retained.
scope.eta_readout: Cumulative Simpson values and sampled penalties are not continuous certified eta bounds
scope.BVP_center_freed: Prepared is only an initial seed; all four genuine odd center corrections remain free in the original ten-parameter BVP.
scope.full_history: The original true A=M integral and both C2 rho histories are integrated along this same new guide; negative side uses reflected geometry, J*A, physical (a,-b), and minus the entire history derivative.
scope.fixed_gauge: One pair of global center-null constants is fitted over both sides, with factored nubar pairing; no per-node or per-copy gauge.
scope.gauge_scale: One fixed positive unit from the new guide actual positive energies replaces the old r0=1 reference unit. Original nu/nubar/nuhat and all unscaled physical defects remain reported.
scope.original_mass_equations: At every stage the two real accelerations a,b are algebraic unknowns constrained by both original ruling equations. Their uniquely invertible elimination gives exactly the old complete Cramer RHS.
scope.new_discrete_system: N stages have 21N+10 unknowns, 19(N-1) differential equations, 2N original ruling equations, and 29 unchanged boundary conditions. No rank follows from this count.
scope.exact_AD: 31-variable true local derivative, including all center, gauge, chart, history and acceleration derivatives; sparse local stage blocks plus ten global columns
scope.differential_row_units: All 19 differential row units fixed to 1, independent of large Cramer accelerations
scope.ruling_row_units: Only two actual ruling residuals use a frozen energy unit for merit; unscaled residuals remain explicit and convergence requires original units
scope.globalization: Damped sparse LSMR with reversible column scaling and finite strict merit decrease; rejection preserves the last completed accepted state
scope.accepted_state_output: All 21 rows, all ten parameters, fixed units, actual defects, trust/damping and canonical SHA are printed before inspections, stdout only
scope.stable_physical_interpolation: Direct Hermite basis with stored exact endpoint values; original endpoint equality is reported. Unclosed independent midpoints are not silently used as cubic values.
scope.actual_geometric_budget: New guide uses the original frame/alpha ODE, double-sided collar edges, sampled base diameter and principal-curvature focal cap; true actual first-field and exact curvature-variation readouts use all 18 physical copies. These are not a finite flex or continuous reach certificate.
scope.conditional_refinement: Only original differential and ruling max <=1e-7 and all original BC <=1e-10 trigger one same-input mesh refinement
scope.necessary_definition_rebuild: The paid formulas are rebuilt only to generate the new physical-mother coefficients; the complete cost is counted. No old highest-square identity or old RHS directional diagnostic is repeated.
scope.new_coefficient_precision_boundary: One 192-order new table is used for this first solve. Any candidate still needs candidate-specific quadrature/precision refinement; a finite row residual is not declared an exact continuous root.
scope.local_checks: AST, JSON, source binding and hashing only; no scientific imports or execution
scope.finite_search_guard: The actual stage/parameter coordinates are unchanged. Compare against fixed guard units: 1 for every slot except six rho slots each max(1,maxabs its true seed history), and zeta0 max(1,abs its seed value). Print units at seed/every checkpoint and freeze them. They define a finite search scope only, without modifying physical equations, original residuals, AD, or column preconditioning.
